title: Credentialing Requirements and Setup Timelines — Physician Client Accounts
content:
Under Physician Client Accounts, an account goes live only once the credentialing documents listed for its account class have been received. The requirements and the two setup clocks differ by class, as set out below.

## Requirements by class

| Account class | Documents required before activation | Business associate agreement must be on file |
|---|---|---|
| Independent Practice Client Account | NPI verification; signed client agreement; business associate agreement | Yes |
| Group Practice Client Account | NPI verification; signed client agreement; business associate agreement | Yes |
| Multispecialty Medical Group Account | NPI verification; signed client agreement; business associate agreement | Yes |
| Federally Qualified Health Center Account | NPI verification; signed client agreement; business associate agreement; HRSA designation letter | Yes |
| Hospital Outreach Reference Account | NPI verification; signed client agreement; business associate agreement; CLIA certificate | Yes |
| Occupational Health Employer Account | Signed client agreement; employer identification number | No |

## Setup clocks by class

| Account class | Setup completed within (business days after the agreement and credentialing documents are received) | Incomplete setup closed after (calendar days from the date the account was opened) |
|---|---|---|
| Independent Practice Client Account | 5 | 30 |
| Group Practice Client Account | 5 | 30 |
| Multispecialty Medical Group Account | 10 | 45 |
| Federally Qualified Health Center Account | 10 | 45 |
| Hospital Outreach Reference Account | 15 | 60 |
| Occupational Health Employer Account | 5 | 30 |

## Points of reference

**Which classes do not need a business associate agreement on file?** Only the Occupational Health Employer Account. Its documents are the signed client agreement and the employer identification number; NPI verification is not among them.

**Which classes need a document beyond NPI verification, the signed client agreement and the business associate agreement?** The Federally Qualified Health Center Account (an HRSA designation letter) and the Hospital Outreach Reference Account (a CLIA certificate).

**From when does each clock run?** The business-day clock runs from receipt of the agreement and credentialing documents; the calendar-day clock runs from the date the account was opened.

**Illustration (hypothetical dates).** A Hospital Outreach Reference Account opened on 2 June carries a 60-calendar-day setup limit from 2 June, and once its documents are received the laboratory has 15 business days to complete setup.
